**Management Plan**

- Diagnosis: Likely simple urinary tract infection (bladder infection)  
- Prescribed antibiotics: either Nitrofurantoin or Trimethoprim (dose/route/frequency: 1 tablet twice daily for 3 days)  
- Advice:  
  - Increase fluid intake to help flush infection  
  - Cranberry juice may help symptom relief  
  - Avoid sexual intercourse until symptoms resolve; continue condom use when resuming sexual activity  
- Safety netting: Return or call if symptoms persist after course of antibiotics or worsen (e.g., develop fever, flank pain, malaise) to assess for possible ascending infection (pyelonephritis)  
- STI screening and pregnancy test recommended if symptoms do not improve or as part of follow-up care  
- Follow-up appointment if symptoms do not resolve as planned
